name: bedrock-converse-cache-write
note: A Nova Pro Converse call with a cache point, as printed by the AWS SDK for Java (TokenUsage(InputTokens=1741, ...)) in the accepted answer's follow-up; the field names are the Converse JSON names. The two calls are the first (a write) and the second (a read). totalTokens counts input, output and the cache tiers. A Converse response names no model, so it is passed in.
